scares.description: A worker is suddenly pulled into the crate.
The remains of the goat drop on the roof of the truck after Lex asks: “Where’s the goat?”.
The Tyrannosaurus breaks through the roof of the truck.
The Dilophosaur’s frill opens and it screeches at Dennis.
After Ellie says “Mr. Hammond I think we’re back in business”, a Velociraptor bursts through the wall behind her.
The Velociraptor sudden lunges at Ellie from behind the fence after she finds Mr. Arnold’s arm.
A Velociraptor tips some pots and pans over.
The Velociraptor pokes its head through the air duct that Lex is crawling through.
The Velociraptor jumps at Lex as she is pulled back through the air duct (this is particularly effective in the 3D version).
